children.name: Sinularia polydactyla
children.description: Sinularia polydactyla, known as finger leather coral, is a species of soft coral in the family Alcyoniidae.

children.name: Sinularia flexibilis
children.description: Sinularia flexibilis is a species of soft coral commonly known as either flexible leather coral, slimy leather coral, or spaghetti finger leather coral.
